messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "Switch"
set: ["Switch", "do not switch without doctor changing dose", "do not switch to schedule without doctor", "if you switch from immediate-release metoprolol to the extended-release form", "do not switch between tablets and oral liquid without doctor changing dose", "dose needs may change if you switch to a different brand, strength, or form", "your dose needs may change if you switch to a different brand, strength, or form of this medicine", "interchangeable", "if on one of these combinations", "works in different ways", "none", "No", "making lifestyle changes", "available", "diet change", "dose needs may change if switching to different brand, strength, or form of medicine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
